Hurricane Fence Inc.

The Premier Fence Installation Company Serving Virginia & North Carolina

Hurricane Fence is the leading fence installer serving Virginia and North Carolina, specializing in residential fencing and commercial fencing solutions. We have been committed to 100% customer satisfaction since 1994 and strive to complete each installation with careful attention to detail for lasting results. There’s no better fence builder to partner with for your fencing project in the Mid-Atlantic region. From a wood privacy fence for your backyard to a high-security perimeter for your facility, we offer superior fence services to fit virtually every need and budget.

Hurricane Fence is the leading fence installer serving Virginia and North Carolina, specializing in fence and perimeter security solutions. We have been committed to 100% customer satisfaction since 1994 and strive to complete each installation with careful attention to detail for lasting results. There’s no better fence builder to partner with for your fencing project in the Mid-Atlantic region—we offer superior fence services to fit various needs.

The Products We Offer

Our expert fence builders at Hurricane Fence proudly install durable, attractive fences from reputable manufacturers. Our crew of professional fence installers has extensive experience and will help you select the style and material that’s the right fit for your property. We offer the following products to meet your requirements:

Aluminum Fence

A low-maintenance option offering unparalleled security.

Vinyl Fence

A versatile choice that is easy to install and looks beautiful.

Wood Fence

A durable fence that offers a natural aesthetic.

Chain-Link Fence

Chain-link is strong and offers security for your property.

Composite Fence

These attractive fences are designed to mimic the look of stone.

Automatic Gates

We are the only fence company in Virginia with an in-house operator gate division.

Hurricane Fence Company is proud to be the Richmond & Tidewater area’s exclusive ActiveYards fence distributor. American-made with only the best raw materials, ActiveYards vinyl and aluminum fencing is built to look better and last longer than products from other fence companies. Reach out to us today to see what Hurricane Fence & ActiveYards can do for your home.

All Residential Fencing Options

Commercial Fencing Services

For over 30 years, we have provided tailored perimeter solutions for businesses, government facilities, and high-security sites. Our industrial-grade fences and advanced security options, including M-Rated, ATFP, and K-Rated systems, are designed to meet the highest safety standards.

Data Center Fencing

A streamlined, all-purpose mesh fence application for clear perimeter delineation and security.

Temporary & Event Fencing

Chain link, windscreen, and barricades for events and projects under construction.

High Security Fence Solutions

K-rated, M-rated, ASTM crash-rated gates, and anti-climb barriers for the highest protection.

Gate Operators

Drop arms, turnstiles, swing and slide gates, vertical lift gates, access control, and entry systems.

Large Scale Energy Projects

Fence and panel installation for solar farms and energy infrastructure across the country.

Indoor & Outdoor Cages

Chain link storage containers for facilities and protective enclosures for parks and recreation.

Bollards

Fixed, removable, and retractable bollards that protect storefronts, pedestrians, and critical infrastructure from vehicle impact.

Guard Rails

Galvanized steel in several finishes that works in conjunction with other perimeter solutions.

Sports Facility Fencing & Netting

UV-protected knotted nylon, posts, and accessories for a completely customized application.

Whatever you have in mind for your property, Hurricane Fence can find the perfect solution and install everything flawlessly.

Why Us?

Why Choose Us as Your Fence Contractor?

As one of the region’s most trusted fence contractors, Hurricane Fence is a Blue Ribbon Company with the American Fence Association and has an A+ Better Business Bureau rating. We stand behind our work, and we’re licensed, bonded, and insured for your peace of mind. We’ll do what it takes to ensure you are happy with the results of your project.

Our crews bring decades of hands-on installation experience to every job, from backyard privacy fences and ornamental aluminum to large-scale commercial perimeter systems and high-security solutions. We provide free estimates, transparent project timelines, and the kind of craftsmanship that has kept homeowners and facility managers coming back since 1994. When results matter, trust the fence company that has earned its reputation across Virginia and North Carolina, one installation at a time.

OUR REACH

National Reach With Local Expertise

With roots in Richmond, Hurricane Fence is a leading fence company for residential and commercial installations throughout Virginia and North Carolina. Military bases, government agencies, and commercial facilities count on us for turnkey perimeter security solutions — and homeowners across the Mid-Atlantic trust us for the same attention to detail on their properties.

We operate out of four regional locations, each staffed by local crews who know the terrain, local codes, and the specific demands of their communities

Richmond, VA

Our original home base. As the leading Richmond fence company, we’ve served homeowners and businesses in the Richmond metro area for over 30 years. From Fan District privacy fences to commercial chain link for industrial facilities, our Richmond team handles projects of every scale.

Portsmouth, VA

Serving the Tidewater and Hampton Roads region, our Portsmouth fence company location has deep roots in the community. We’re the go-to contractor for residential neighborhoods and the commercial and government facilities that define this region’s economy.

Northern Virginia, DC & Maryland

Our Northern Virginia, DC, and Maryland commercial fence company team specializes in the high-security, large-scale projects that define the DMV market, government contractors, data centers, defense facilities, and multi-site commercial developments.

Raleigh, NC

Expanding into North Carolina, our Raleigh commercial fence company serves the Triangle’s fast-growing business community and residential market alike. From ornamental aluminum for suburban developments to security fencing for commercial campuses, we bring the same craftsmanship that our Virginia clients have trusted for over three decades.

Contact Hurricane Fence today to learn more about our options and to schedule your fence replacement.
